verdict.rationale: Docs confirm private networking between instances via overlay networks (vast-ai-docs-12/18) and search filters reference 'direct_port_count' implying port exposure capability (vast-ai-docs-20), but there's no dedicated documentation walking through exposing/mapping ports to serve applications (e.g., HTTP endpoints) end-to-end. Missing for 10: explicit port-forwarding/exposure guide, examples of serving a web app via exposed port, and independent verification of overlay networking reliability.
